anchors.rule: Sensitivities run at four anchors on the I-R grid: the starting point; the best passing point (the highest oracle-scanned net among I-R grid points with every check satisfied); that point's ratio-step-lower neighbour and flow-step-higher neighbour on the grid (contract § 10). The anchors are chosen from the oracle scan before any native point runs and recorded in axis-plan.json; the native run then confirms or corrects the reading.
